title: Computer Science Student Resume Guide 2026: Format, Templates & Project Examples
description: Step-by-step technical resume guide for Computer Science undergraduate and graduate students. How to land SWE internships and full-time roles.
body:
Computer Science students face a unique challenge: translating academic coursework and personal coding projects into commercial-grade engineering capability on a single page. In 2026, tech recruiters filter through hundreds of resumes per opening, prioritizing verifiable project architecture, clean version control, and concrete technical metrics.

## 1. Optimal CS Student Resume Layout

- Header: Full Name, Email, Phone, LinkedIn, GitHub, and Portfolio / Live Demo URL.
- Education: Degree (B.Tech / B.S. in Computer Science), University Name, Expected Graduation Date, GPA (if > 3.5/4.0 or > 8.0/10.0), and Key Coursework (Data Structures & Algorithms, Distributed Systems, Operating Systems, Database Management Systems).
- Technical Skills: Programming Languages, Frameworks & Libraries, Cloud & Databases, DevOps & Tools.
- Featured Engineering Projects (3-4 Projects): Title, Tech Stack, Live Links, and 3 XYZ impact bullets per project.
- Work Experience / Open Source / Hackathons: Internships, research assistantships, or competitive programming achievements (LeetCode, Codeforces rating).

## 2. High-Impact Project Archetypes for CS Students

- Archetype 1: Distributed / Systems Project (e.g., a Redis-compatible in-memory key-value store in Go or Rust with RESP protocol support).
- Archetype 2: Full-Stack Real-Time Application (e.g., an interactive Kanban board with WebSocket live collaboration and PostgreSQL).
- Archetype 3: AI / LLM Application (e.g., a multi-document RAG question-answering tool with hybrid vector search and streaming UI).

## 3. Formatting with LaTeX vs. Word

LaTeX templates (such as Jake's Resume or Deedy Resume) remain the industry gold standard for technical resumes. They generate pristine, uncorrupted typography with zero visual layout drift across different ATS parsers.

faq.q: Should CS students include non-technical jobs on their resume?
faq.a: Only if you lack technical projects. Once you have 3 solid software projects or an internship, replace non-technical jobs with technical accomplishments.
